title: Experiment identity and recording metadata
description: One experiment's identity, recording locations, and study metadata — the canonical JSON document decided by D05 (docs/adr/0002-json-parameter-documents.md). Maps 1:1 to this experiment's experiments.csv row; the _csv section preserves every raw cell verbatim so lab-specific columns survive the round trip. Directory fields hold the RAW csv values (relative to the lab's data_path), never pre-joined absolute paths.

line_number.description: Unique experiment identifier; matches lab_config time_windows keys.

box_calcium_folder_id.description: Optional Box folder ID for automatic miniscope-data download.

calcium_imaging_directory.description: Miniscope recording folder, relative to the lab's data_path.

box_ephys_folder_id.description: Optional Box folder ID for automatic ephys-data download.

ephys_directory.description: Neuralynx recording folder, relative to the lab's data_path.

channels.description: Available channel names (the .ncs filenames without extension).

_csv.description: Verbatim CSV passthrough: column order and raw cell strings from the source row, preserved so writeback is non-destructive for unknown lab-specific columns (D05 export-coverage rule).
